gaps.detail: Only bounded pdf_inspection_v1 run profile is wired; full BIE pipeline creation/start remains integration work.
Pause/resume/cancel requests are persisted truthfully but actual worker/orchestrator acknowledgement remains required.
Retry creates canonical READY attempt; queue/orchestrator dispatch binding remains required.
Graph viewer uses explicit bie.graph.v1 contract; canonical graph artifact adapters must be verified.
Existing local API has no authentication; production authorization and tenant boundaries remain later work.
Static operator UI and API are present; hosted browser/native mobile flows remain required.
